metadata.coverage: Bergen, Passaic, Sussex, Warren, Morris counties (northern NJ)
metadata.sourceCSV: nj_trout_pins.csv (155 pins; 27 wild-stream Tier 0 markers + 1 Picatinny restricted dropped)
metadata.verified: Filtered to NJ bbox; 9 wildly-wrong geocodes (other states/countries) removed
metadata.notes: Some pins are approximate. Bridge pins may snap to road center rather than exact stream crossing. Drop replacement pins manually as you visit each spot.
